command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(id -un)" = ai-core-node; PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value); echo PID=$PID; test "$PID" != 0; echo '=== CMDLINE ==='; tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/"$PID"/cmdline; echo; echo '=== CHILDREN ==='; pgrep -P "$PID" || true; echo '=== ESTABLISHED TCP OWNED BY VOICE PID ==='; if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -Pan -p "$PID" -iTCP -sTCP:ESTABLISHED 2>/dev/null || true; else ss -Htnp 2>/dev/null | grep "pid=$PID," || true; fi; echo '=== SERVICE ==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service --no-pager -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ExecStart
